scope: Read-only sample of overlap between the M2 branch and existing uncommitted files in the main checkout; not a merge or conflict-resolution test.
method: Compared branch-changed paths to porcelain status with all untracked files expanded, then compared Git-normalized working-file hashes with the base and candidate blobs. Git ran without optional index locks and hash-object was used without writing objects. Raw porcelain output matched before and after the sample.
limitations: The sample is non-atomic; unchanged status output does not prove file contents or refs remained unchanged during the entire audit.
Differing hashes are not proof of merge conflicts or semantic incompatibility. Matching untracked files can still prevent a checkout or merge.
Staged content outside the overlap, directory collisions and other worktrees were not audited. No files, branches or user changes were merged or replaced.
All native, restore ownership, resource and milestone acceptance gates remain open.
